drawing-ink.$description: Drawing Ink — Primary text, dark product panels, dark feature sections, icons, and structural strokes

paper.$description: Paper — Page canvas, card surfaces, light product panels, and reversed text

drafting-gray.$description: Drafting Gray — Muted card surfaces, logo tiles, product-widget backgrounds, and secondary action surfaces

hairline.$description: Hairline — 1px card, navigation, and input-like dividers

stone.$description: Stone — Muted helper text, secondary metadata, and low-emphasis interface marks

graphite.$description: Graphite — Supporting body copy on light surfaces

archive-black.$description: Archive Black — Footer canvas and the deepest visual anchor

signal-lime.$description: Signal Lime — Filled demo buttons, active selection, announcement highlights, and graphic framing — the acid-lime mark punctures the otherwise monochrome document palette

blueprint-wash.$description: Blueprint Wash — Pale blue feature-card surface for specification and document workflows

material-wash.$description: Material Wash — Pale warm feature-card surface for architectural content modules

site-wash.$description: Site Wash — Pale green-tinted feature-card surface

review-status.$description: Review Status — In-review status badges in product interfaces

input-status.$description: Input Status — Needs-input status badges in product interfaces

complete-status.$description: Complete Status — Green wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

plan-blue.$description: Plan Blue — Blue wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content

aspekta.$description: The site-wide sans for display headings, body copy, navigation, buttons, badges, and product UI. Weight 650 carries the broad, tightly packed statements; weight 350 keeps utility navigation and body metadata thin and technical rather than corporate.

ui-monospace.$description: Sparse technical labels and machine-like product metadata, set with tight -0.36px tracking to make document references feel system-generated.
